raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-STP-YouthEmployment",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Fragile state context may limit institutional capacity to implement and monitor project activities effectively.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish robust technical assistance, regular capacity‑building workshops for MLSSS and training institutions, and embed performance‑based milestones.",
      "evidence": "Financing & Implementation Modalities: marked as Fragile State(s) and Small State(s)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Construction of the new training centre on Príncipe could be delayed or damaged by climate‑related hazards (floods, landslides).",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt EDGE‑certified, climate‑resilient design, conduct detailed geotechnical studies, and include contingency time and budget for weather‑related disruptions.",
      "evidence": "Section 30‑31: new centre construction with climate‑resilient design; climate hazards listed in Section 4."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Limited capacity of existing TVET institutions (outdated equipment, staffing gaps) may reduce training quality and throughput.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted equipment upgrades, hire additional qualified instructors, and implement a monitoring checklist for curriculum and facility standards.",
      "evidence": "Section 12: institutions have outdated equipment, limited staffing, and capacity constraints."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "The Employment Observatory and Employability Portal have never been fully operationalized, risking failure to deliver integrated labor market information.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Allocate dedicated IT project management, pilot the system in a limited region before full rollout, and set clear data‑entry and usage KPIs.",
      "evidence": "Section 32‑34: Observatory previously developed but never fully operationalized; portal yet to be launched."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Financial management weaknesses (delayed transaction recording, internal audit lag) could cause fund misuse or reporting delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Appoint an experienced accountant, customize the accounting system for real‑time tracking, and schedule quarterly internal audit reviews.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary section: FM risks include delays in recording transactions and internal audit reviews."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Procurement processes may be slowed by coordination between AFAP and multiple ministries, risking schedule overruns.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a joint procurement task‑force with clear TORs, fast‑track approval matrices, and pre‑qualified vendor lists.",
      "evidence": "Procurement section: success depends on AFAP and MLSSS close collaboration; technical inputs required from ministries."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Social exclusion risk: vulnerable youth (especially women, remote island residents) may not be reached by training or scholarships.",
      "category": "social",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use USR data for targeted outreach, set minimum geographic and gender quotas, and monitor enrollment disaggregated by sex and location.",
      "evidence": "Beneficiaries section: focus on vulnerable youth, at least 50% women, use USR for targeting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Risk of sexual exploitation, abuse or harassment (SEA/SH) for young women participating in internships or training.",
      "category": "social",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Hire a dedicated SEA/SH specialist, implement strict code of conduct, provide safe‑housing options, and establish a confidential grievance mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Legal covenants: requirement to hire Social Specialist with GBV/SEA/SH expertise."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Gender‑related barriers (time poverty, limited asset ownership) may limit women’s participation and benefit realization.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate childcare support at training sites, schedule flexible class times, and provide gender‑sensitive communication and outreach.",
      "evidence": "Section 9 & 63: women face higher poverty, limited participation; gender‑responsive measures described."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Low absorption capacity of the domestic private sector could limit placement of trained youth into decent jobs.",
      private: true,
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen private‑sector engagement through Workforce Development Committees, develop apprenticeship contracts, and diversify into export‑oriented value chains.",
      "evidence": "Section 11: firms report skills shortages; limited private sector size; reliance on SMEs."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Labor‑mobility component depends on partnerships with overseas employers; failure to secure agreements reduces migration pathways.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formalize MoUs with destination‑country employers early, and embed labor‑mobility targets in performance contracts.",
      "evidence": "Section 24‑25: labor mobility lens, partnerships with overseas employers to advertise opportunities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Climate‑related shocks (floods, droughts) may disrupt training sessions and field activities, especially on remote Príncipe.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include backup power generators, develop contingency schedules, and shift to blended (online/off‑site) delivery when weather permits.",
      "evidence": "Section 32: purchase of power generators for backup during intense rainfall and floods."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Potential elite capture or mis‑targeting of scholarships and grants, undermining equity objectives.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement transparent selection criteria linked to USR data, conduct independent audits of beneficiary lists, and publish selection outcomes.",
      "evidence": "Social risk section: risk of exclusion and elite capture if benefits not equitably distributed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Delays in CERC activation could leave the project unable to respond swiftly to emergencies, affecting vulnerable beneficiaries.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Finalize CERC Manual before effectiveness, conduct simulation exercises, and pre‑approve trigger criteria with the Bank.",
      "evidence": "Component 4: CERC activation procedures and manual to be prepared after effectiveness."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Coordination challenges among multiple ministries (MLSSS, MECSHE, MAFRD, MEYST) may cause duplicated efforts or gaps.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set up a high‑level coordination committee with clear terms of reference and joint work plans, meeting quarterly.",
      "evidence": "Implementation section: coordination committee under Minister of Labor comprising MLSSS, DTEFP, DPSSF."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Reliance on external consultants for design, IT development, and evaluation may create schedule risk if contracts are delayed.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare detailed TORs early, use pre‑qualified consultant pool, and include penalty clauses for late delivery.",
      "evidence": "Procurement section: consulting services represent largest volume of contracts."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Environmental impact from construction and equipment procurement could affect sensitive ecosystems if not managed.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct ESIA for all works, enforce waste‑management plans, and monitor compliance with EDGE and local environmental regulations.",
      "evidence": "Environmental & Social Framework: moderate risk, potential solid waste and construction debris."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Data quality issues in the new labor market information system could undermine evidence‑based decision‑making.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement data‑validation protocols, train staff on data entry standards, and perform periodic data audits.",
      "evidence": "Monitoring & Evaluation Plan: system usage measured; risk of poor data quality implied."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Political/Policy shifts in GoSTP could alter priority value chains, affecting relevance of training curricula.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Embed flexibility clauses allowing sector re‑prioritization, and maintain continuous dialogue with the Ministry of Economy and Finance.",
      "evidence": "Program Framework: countries may adjust priority sectors during implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Insufficient private‑sector financing to scale MSME productivity grants may limit grant disbursement.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Leverage the Project for Results (PforR) mechanism to crowd‑in private capital and set up a revolving grant fund.",
      "evidence": "Component 2: MSME productivity and expansion grants up to US$50,000; reliance on private‑sector uptake."
    }
  ]
}
